definitions.explanation: A professionally qualified museum or gallery staff member responsible for managing and interpreting collections. In Japan, this is an official certification requiring specific university coursework.

examples.japanese: {学芸員|がくげいいん}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}る。
{学芸員|がくげいいん}が{展示|てんじ}の{解説|かいせつ}をしてくれた。
examples.english: A curator gave us an explanation of the exhibit.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}の{学芸員|がくげいいん}として{働|はたら}くには、{専門|せんもん}の{知識|ちしき}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Working as a curator at an art museum requires specialized knowledge.

notes: Composed of {学芸|がくげい} (arts and sciences) + {員|いん} (member/staff). The {学芸員|がくげいいん} qualification is defined by the {博物館法|はくぶつかんほう} (Museum Act) and requires completing designated university courses. {学芸員|がくげいいん}{補|ほ} is an assistant curator. Related term: {キュレーター} (curator, from English) is also used, especially in contemporary art contexts.
